aggressive_definition: Aggressive prostate cancer was defined as T4, N1, M1, or Gleason score 8–10; lethal prostate cancer was also analyzed separately.
aggressive_definition_excerpt: Clinical features of prostate cancer included stage, grade, lethal and aggressive (T4 or N1 or M1 or Gleason 8-10) outcome.
study_design: Prospective cohort study (Health Professionals Follow-up Study, 1986–2016)
cohort_total_n_excerpt: A total of 47,240 men from the Health Professionals Follow-up Study were followed from 1986 to 2016.
reason: The abstract reports incident overall prostate cancer and explicitly defined incident aggressive and lethal prostate cancer outcomes in a prospective cohort.
